facts.fact: The article states that law 25-11, promulgated in July 2025, amends law 18-07 and imposes data protection delegate, processing register and automated operations log duties, which the ANPDP presses bodies to meet; the article's date is an estimated month.
facts.system: Loi n° 18-07 du 10 juin 2018 (as amended by loi n° 25-11)

facts.fact: The article reports the ANPDP's first study day and a series of training and awareness meetings with national bodies, and calls on public and private bodies to declare their activities and appoint a data protection delegate; it reports no decision.
facts.system: Loi n° 18-07 du 10 juin 2018 (as amended by loi n° 25-11)

facts.fact: The article states that the ANPDP issues authorisations and receives declarations of processing under article 25 and that it organised a study day.
